sourceSentences: Mordekaiser generates a stack for each enemy champion or large monster damaged by his basic attacks or hit by his basic abilities, lasting for 4 seconds, refreshing on subsequent triggers, and stacking up to 3 times. At 3 stacks, he gains Darkness Rise.
Mordekaiser will still generate Darkness Rise stacks from hitting his abilities even if they deal no damage, such as if the target is invulnerable or blocks an ability with a spell shield.
Mordekaiser strikes his mace down in a line in the target direction, dealing magic damage to enemies within, increased if only one enemy is hit.
The ability will cast to wherever the caster's cursor was at the start of the cast time.
Indestructible can be recast after 0.5 seconds while the shield is active. Recast: Mordekaiser consumes the remaining shield, healing for a portion of the amount.
Death's Grasp will still pull even if Mordekaiser dies.
Death's Grasp will only be visible from the enemy team's perspective if it is at least 300 units into their sight.
Realm of Death will cancel and go on cooldown after its cast time if the target is displacement immune, crowd control immune or protected by a spell shield.
Entering or leaving the Death Realm will cause all targeted projectiles to be destroyed.
Upon entering the realm, Mordekaiser and the target are cleansed from all forced action effects.

For combos, your go to is to attack into Q before attacking into E and attacking away. When engaging, simply land E into your Q and attack away. And your all in is to E into your ultimate and a Q before attacking away. And in all these combos, use your W and fully stacked for the massive shield.

For your full trading combo, pull the enemy in with your E and then land your Q and auto attack. You can then keep attacking and whenever you want, activate your W to get a shield and after the fight, use it again to heal yourself.
For your all-in with your ultimate, pull the enemy in and when they get to you, use your ultimate. You can then auto attack Q auto attack to trigger your passive and when you need it, use your W.
